meta.name: Three-VM node-ready
meta.description: Install Node.js 22.x on host, agent, and visitor VMs and point @lamalibre at the Feria dev registry.

sections.label: Install Node.js 22.x and configure Feria registry

steps.label: Install Node.js + Feria registry on host
steps.bash:
set -euo pipefail
# The orchestrator's uplink may be a tunnel (a VPN: MTU 1420) that drops ICMP
# "fragmentation needed" for the VMs' NATed traffic: full-size TLS packets then
# vanish (connection resets, timeouts to npmjs and GitHub). 1400 fits every common
# tunnel. Persisted on the netplan entry rodeo's static address extends
# (`default`), so it survives the tier's snapshot/restore and a reboot; set at
# once as well — `netplan apply` here could drop the exec session running this.
printf 'network:\n  version: 2\n  ethernets:\n    default:\n      mtu: 1400\n' > /etc/netplan/99-lamaste-mtu.yaml
chmod 600 /etc/netplan/99-lamaste-mtu.yaml
ip link set dev "$(ip route | awk '/default/{print $5; exit}')" mtu 1400
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "npm already available ($(npm --version))"
else
  apt-get update
  apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
  apt-get install -y nodejs
fi
GATEWAY="$(ip route | awk '/default/{print $3; exit}')"
if [ -z "${GATEWAY}" ]; then GATEWAY="192.168.2.1"; fi
printf '@lamalibre:registry=http://%s:4873\n' "${GATEWAY}" | tee /root/.npmrc /home/ubuntu/.npmrc >/dev/null
